## Analysis

Source-limited test fixture for the supplied synthetic Primary pack, not a current analytical golden. Search scope: the Primary registry's issuer/market financial releases, annual/quarterly filings, synthetic Sector RV workbook, levels export and capitalisation/term-sheet files. MGM and PENN have operating releases; the workbook identifies Station Casinos, PENN, Light & Wonder, Golden Entertainment and Fertitta, but supplies loan relative-value fields rather than aligned operating financials. Caesars' two facilities are the borrower, not two peers. The workbook explicitly labels every figure synthetic and not a market observation.

No four comparable operating peers can be established from these materials. Equipment and hospitality candidates require business/perimeter reconciliation; PENN's workbook yield/DM cells are unavailable. No missing operating figure is replaced with a loan yield. Qualify definitions, periods, currency, unit and perimeter before aggregation. With no qualified operating observations, N is zero and all distribution statistics and borrower positioning remain unavailable. No calculator or source citation is claimed for an unsupported number.

The strongest counter-case is that loan-level relative value offers useful monitoring context. It cannot establish operating leverage tolerance or an EBITDA valuation multiple; source-backed aligned peer statements would make that case usable. A borrower downside path and numerical transmission cannot be inferred from missing peer fundamentals. CP-2 and CP-3 must retain the gap and use their supported borrower analysis; this fixture makes no ranking or valuation conclusion.

## Gaps

- High: four aligned operating peers are missing. MGM/PENN releases alone do not meet the four-peer quartile floor. Obtain peer financial statements with matching period, accounting/adjustment basis, currency, unit, perimeter and provenance; until then CP-2/CP-3/CP-6 cannot rely on peer distribution positioning.
- The synthetic Sector RV workbook's loan prices, YTM and discount margins are not revenue, EBITDA, FCF, leverage or EV denominators. Station Casinos, Golden Entertainment, Light & Wonder and Fertitta lack the operating evidence needed here. Business-model/perimeter differences require explicit reconciliation; no unassessed candidate counts in N.
- Borrower metric and age/definition alignment are deliberately unpopulated in this Blocked fixture. Obtain current CP-1/MODEL values and cited peer measurement dates before constructing calculator input. No outlier version can restore missing comparables.
- No sourced equity/transaction EV component set or same-period borrower denominator establishes implied EV. Supply dated trading/transaction evidence separately; no indicative EV or recovery conclusion is available.
